issues.description: Method parameter mismatch for Rideable.messageOnRide: The problem statement (UML and textual requirements) defines a parameterless method messageOnRide() that returns a String and the template Main.java calls r.messageOnRide() with no arguments. The solution repository instead defines Rideable.messageOnRide(String equipment) and implements Pig.messageOnRide(String) and Seal.messageOnRide(String). This inconsistency prevents students from compiling or matching the described API: code written to the problem statement/template will not satisfy the solution signatures, and following the solution will contradict the documented exercise and example usage.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the messageOnRide signature consistent across all artifacts. Two viable options: (A) Change the solution to match the problem/template by removing the equipment parameter: define Rideable.messageOnRide() : String and update Pig/Seal implementations to return e.g. "Riding on Pig [name]" and "Riding on Seal [name]"; or (B) Update the problem statement and template to require messageOnRide(String equipment) (update the UML, textual description, and the Main.java example to call r.messageOnRide("<equipment>") and show expected outputs such as "Riding on Pig [name] with [equipment]"). Choose (A) if the exercise intends a parameterless ride message, or (B) if the equipment detail is pedagogically required.

issues.description: The concept 'ride action message' is inconsistently specified across artifacts. The problem statement (UML and text) and the template's example calls define/use a no-argument method named messageOnRide() that returns a String (problem statement: Rideable.messageOnRide():String; instructions: messageOnRide() should return "Riding on [Animal Type] [name]"). The solution repository instead defines Rideable.messageOnRide(String equipment) and implements messageOnRide(String equipment) in Pig and Seal. This signature mismatch (no-arg vs. one String parameter) prevents students from mapping the required no-argument operation to the solution code and will cause compilation errors for the example calls (r.messageOnRide()) shown in the template/Main and described in the problem.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Rideable.messageOnRide signature consistent across all artifacts. Preferred fix: change the solution's Rideable to declare String messageOnRide() (no parameters) and update Pig and Seal to implement messageOnRide() returning strings per the problem spec (e.g., "Riding on Pig [name]" and "Riding on Seal [name]"). Alternatively, if the equipment parameter is intended, update the problem statement and template Main examples to require/illustrate messageOnRide(String equipment) (and show example calls like r.messageOnRide("saddle")).
